exam_scheme.note: Admission to undergraduate and postgraduate design and fashion technology programmes across 18 NIFT campuses nationwide is administered by the National Testing Agency (NTA). For Bachelor of Design (B.Des), selection comprises three stages: General Ability Test (GAT) in Computer Based Test mode, Creative Ability Test (CAT) in paper-and-pencil mode, and a hands-on Situation Test for shortlisted candidates. Final B.Des composite merit is calculated with 50% weightage to CAT, 30% weightage to GAT, and 20% weightage to the Situation Test. Bachelor of Fashion Technology (B.F.Tech) requires only the GAT (100% weightage).
